climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A South West appellation in the Pyrenees foothills, making dry white wine and a more sought-after sweet white. Both come from Petit Manseng and Gros Manseng on steep slopes, with tropical aromas such as pineapple and mango in the sweet wines.
